truth_frontmatter.change_reason: R1: add lifecycle exit clean-workspace gate; split formal/runtime evidence; isolate post-release projections

acceptance_criteria.theme: 提供 `verify_clean_workspace`（或等价）统一出口 gate，读取完整 `git status --porcelain=v1 -uall`，按 artifact_role 分类并对 unclassified dirty fail-closed
dirty manifest 至少区分 `canonical_truth`、`formal_evidence`、`machine_projection`、`host_projection`、`runtime_private`、`forbidden`，并给出每类允许动作
formal evidence manifest 仅可包含 tracked、branch-carried、hash-valid 的正式证据；local hook/runtime evidence 必须进入 runtime manifest 或 ignored state，不能支撑 QA/release verdict
tasks.md 中 `[x] + evidence=PATH` 必须要求 evidence 文件存在、可解析、tracked/promoted、并被 evidence.md 或 formal manifest 索引；`[ ] + existing evidence` 必须作为 orphan evidence 阻断或要求清理
agent_trace 写入前必须执行 redline/allowlist gate，禁止 `full_chat`、非空 `chat_body`、raw messages、prompt/completion、token/cookie/env/private key 等字段写入或 promotion
raw `.beacon/traces/**` 默认分类为 `runtime_private`；正式证据只能使用脱敏 digest，digest 含 event_count、harness、feature_slug、reason_codes、sha256、`redaction_status=pass`
`beacon-post-release-local-install` 默认在临时 git worktree 或等价隔离区执行 project-local agent/context projection；原 project_root 运行前后快照不得新增 tracked dirty
`quiet-worktree`/skip-worktree 只能作为开发者降噪；`verify-clean-workspace --strict` 必须揭示 skip-worktree hidden dirty，且不允许 skip-worktree hidden dirty 进入 `clean_verified` 或被当作 clean proof
host projection 必须二选一：local-only ignore/skip 策略，或 deterministic `surface-sync` commit；禁止 release 后留下未提交 `.agents/.codex/.cursor/.trae/.windsurf` 投影改动
truth/freeze/qa/release/post-release 出口都必须调用 clean-workspace gate 或记录同 schema verification bundle；失败 reason_code 明确指向 commit、promote、ignore、clean 或 rerun route
pre-push/main-push profile 必须阻断 generator dirty 与 unclassified dirty，不再只检查 staged business paths；business code main guard 仍保留为 defense-in-depth
release human gate 保持最高边界；clean-workspace pass 不等于 release pass，post-release hook pass 也不等于 QA/release verdict

test_rows.assertion: full porcelain status is classified and unclassified dirty blocks
runtime hook evidence cannot satisfy formal release evidence
checked task requires tracked evidence; unchecked existing evidence reports orphan_evidence_unpromoted
forbidden trace fields return agent_trace_redline_field and no file is written
raw trace is runtime_private; digest has redaction_status=pass and sha256
pre/post root snapshots match except ignored runtime state
illegal transition skip-worktree-hidden dirty → clean proof is blocked
host projection dirty blocks unless local-only or deterministic sync commit policy is satisfied
truth/freeze/qa/release/post-release profiles emit same clean gate schema
main-push blocks generator and unclassified dirty beyond staged business code
clean pass leaves release human confirmation required
exec suite covers clean-workspace exit gate
trace redline and digest contract present
